answer.summary: API Types Check failed because the committed generated TypeScript types are stale. The PR adds API output fields and a new StarterPackDashboardsRestoreOutput type, but the generator was not re-run and committed. The job prints an explicit 'Forgot to generate types' message. Re-running will fail the same way until the developer runs yarn generate-types-from-api and commits the result.

evidence.quote: /** Starter-pack dashboards restored and tenant defaults set back */
⚠️ Forgot to generate types! Please run 'yarn run generate-types-from-api' before committing.
